analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 甲型流感病毒 (IAV),包括 H5N1 和 H7N9 等 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 毒株,通过 免疫应答 失调引起严重的呼吸道疾病,特别是由过度的 NLRP3 炎性体激活引起的细胞因子风暴。该研究旨在阐明半乳糖凝集素 3 (Gal3) 在协调不同病毒血凝素 (HA) 亚型的 NLRP3 炎症小体激活中的调节作用。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用体外病毒结合和内化测定以及小鼠体内感染模型,研究了 Gal3 加剧甲型流感病毒 发病机制 的双重机制。该研究重点关注 Gal3 与病毒 HA 亚型(H5N1、H1N1、H7N9)之间的相互作用及其对炎症小体激活的下游影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行病毒结合和内化测定以评估细胞外 Gal3 对病毒进入不同 HA 亚型的影响。通过评估 Gal3 在维持 NF-κB 激活以上调 NLRP3 和 pro-IL-1β 转录以及促进 NLRP3-ASC-pro-caspase-1 相互作用和 ASC 寡聚化方面的作用来检查细胞内机制。
analysis_zh.main_results: 细胞外 Gal3 以毒株依赖性方式促进病毒进入,其中对 H5N1 的作用最强,其次是 H1N1 和 H7N9。在体内,Gal3 缺陷小鼠的存活率显着提高,体重减轻减少,肺部炎症减轻,感染后 IL-1β 释放减少,对 H5N1 的保护作用最明显。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果确定 Gal3 是一个关键的 宿主 因子,它同时促进病毒进入并驱动 NLRP3 炎性体组装,从而在甲型流感病毒感染期间协调过度炎症。这种双阶段机制凸显了 Gal3-NLRP3 轴作为减轻流感引起的严重肺损伤的新型治疗靶点。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究表明,针对 Gal3-NLRP3 轴可以通过限制病毒进入和过度炎症反应来减轻严重流感病例的疾病严重程度,特别是由 H5N1 等高致病性毒株引起的病例。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅来自摘要,这限制了详细的方法和结果报告,可能会省略关键控制、样本量和统计分析。因此,证据的强度是中等的,有待全面的方法和结果验证。

title: Determinants of highly pathogenic avian influenza spread during bird migration
abstract: Abstract Migratory waterfowl are central to the global spread of the Goose/Guangdong lineage of H5 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI), yet the parameters and processes shaping their role remain poorly understood, with evidence scattered across studies focused on narrow sets of parameters. Here, we synthesized current knowledge to identify 43 parameters and developed a spatially explicit agent-based model of waterfowl migration to evaluate the influence of 28 of these parameters on nine HPAI outcomes. Our results show that migratory waterfowl contribute most to HPAI spread and risk under conditions of high bird-to-bird transmission rate, long infectious periods and greater aggregation of birds at stop-over sites. When aggregation level is held constant, lower overlap in migratory routes among individuals (‘spatial alignment’) further amplifies waterfowl contributions by extending infection maintenance in waterfowl population and the environment. These results suggest that a few viral parameters shape much of infection dynamics, but also that migration behaviour, via aggregation and spatial alignment, plays a comparably large role within our model. Viral traits strongly shaped infection prevalence in waterfowl and incursion risk to poultry, whereas migratory behaviour more strongly shaped outbreak timing, maintenance and spatial distribution. These findings underscore the importance of integrating waterfowl movement ecology into HPAI risk models and assessments.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the determinants of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) spread during bird migration, focusing on the role of migratory waterfowl. The research aimed to address the lack of understanding regarding the parameters and processes that shape HPAI transmission dynamics. Using a spatially explicit agent-based model, the study evaluated the influence of 28 parameters on nine HPAI outcomes. The results indicated that high bird-to-bird transmission rates, long infectious periods, and greater aggregation at stop-over sites significantly contribute to HPAI spread and risk. Additionally, lower overlap in migratory routes (spatial alignment) further amplifies the role of waterfowl in maintaining infections. The findings suggest that both viral parameters and migration behavior, particularly aggregation and spatial alignment, play critical roles in infection dynamics. These results emphasize the need to integrate waterfowl movement ecology into HPAI risk models for improved surveillance and outbreak prediction. The study's reliance on an abstract-only model and synthesis of existing knowledge limits the confidence in its findings, though the evidence is considered moderate in strength due to the comprehensive parameter evaluation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解鸟类迁徙过程中影响 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 传播的因素,因为迁徙水禽是其全球传播的核心,但影响其作用的参数和过程仍知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究综合了当前的知识,确定了 43 个参数,并开发了一个基于空间显式代理的水禽迁徙模型,以评估 28 个参数对 9 个 HPAI 结果的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用基于空间显式代理的水禽迁徙模型来评估 28 个参数对 9 个 HPAI 结果的影响,综合当前知识以确定 43 个参数。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,在禽类 传播 率高、传染期长、中途停留地鸟类聚集较多的情况下,迁徙水禽对 HPAI 传播和风险贡献最大。当聚集水平保持不变时,个体之间迁徙路线的较低重叠(“空间对齐”)会通过延长水禽种群和环境中的感染维持来进一步放大水禽的贡献。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,一些病毒参数在很大程度上影响了感染动态,而且通过聚集和空间排列的迁移行为在模型中发挥着相对重要的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了将水禽运动生态学纳入 HPAI 风险模型和评估以更好地预测和管理 暴发 的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于当前知识和模型的抽象综合,这可能会限制研究结果的可信度,但由于综合参数评估,证据的强度被认为是中等的。

title_zh: 鸟类迁徙过程中 高致病性禽流感 传播的决定因素
source_body_en: Abstract Migratory waterfowl are central to the global spread of the Goose/Guangdong lineage of H5 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI), yet the parameters and processes shaping their role remain poorly understood, with evidence scattered across studies focused on narrow sets of parameters. Here, we synthesized current knowledge to identify 43 parameters and developed a spatially explicit agent-based model of waterfowl migration to evaluate the influence of 28 of these parameters on nine HPAI outcomes. Our results show that migratory waterfowl contribute most to HPAI spread and risk under conditions of high bird-to-bird transmission rate, long infectious periods and greater aggregation of birds at stop-over sites. When aggregation level is held constant, lower overlap in migratory routes among individuals (‘spatial alignment’) further amplifies waterfowl contributions by extending infection maintenance in waterfowl population and the environment. These results suggest that a few viral parameters shape much of infection dynamics, but also that migration behaviour, via aggregation and spatial alignment, plays a comparably large role within our model. Viral traits strongly shaped infection prevalence in waterfowl and incursion risk to poultry, whereas migratory behaviour more strongly shaped outbreak timing, maintenance and spatial distribution. These findings underscore the importance of integrating waterfowl movement ecology into HPAI risk models and assessments.

title: Mobility Network Analysis of the Poultry Sector in Morocco: A Tool for the Surveillance and Prevention of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza
abstract: Background: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) poses a critical global threat to both the poultry industry and public health. Although Morocco currently maintains HPAI-free status, the country faces substantial risk due to its location along major migratory flyways and its extensive commercial trade networks within the poultry sector. Available data indicate that the links between live bird markets, production farms, and related facilities in the poultry sector constitute a pivotal determinant of disease epidemiology. This study aimed to analyze these movements and determine how they can influence the spread of the disease and to guide policymakers in developing effective risk-based surveillance and control strategies tailored to the local context.: A questionnaire-based cross-sectional survey was conducted across the Casablanca-Settat region, including nine provinces and 138 municipalities, to investigate the movement patterns within the poultry sector in this region. Social network analysis (SNA) was employed to construct a movement network, and findings were spatially visualized using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and analyzed through network analysis in R.: A total of 945 transport routes were recorded in 126 municipalities. Centrality measures identified three predominant network nodes exhibiting high degree and betweenness centrality values. Our findings indicate that although the network has a low density, the transmission of IAHP remains critical due to frequent bidirectional links and a heterogeneous network structure. The high concentration of movements by a few “hub” municipalities leads to an early emergence and rapid dissemination.: The identification of highly influential nodes allows veterinary authorities to prioritize and target surveillance activities toward municipalities with the greatest likelihood of disease introduction or persistence. The network’s structural connectivity suggests a theoretical potential for rapid HPAI spread, underscoring the importance of the frequent bidirectional links identified between municipalities. This protects both Morocco’s poultry industry and public health.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) threatens poultry industries and public health globally, and Morocco faces heightened risk due to its position along migratory flyways and extensive poultry trade networks. The study addressed a knowledge gap on how poultry movement patterns influence HPAI spread to inform targeted surveillance and control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A questionnaire-based cross-sectional survey was conducted in the Casablanca-Settat region of Morocco, covering nine provinces and 138 municipalities to map poultry movement patterns. The study recorded 945 transport routes across 126 municipalities and used social network analysis (SNA) with GIS visualization to characterize the network structure.
analysis.methods: Social network analysis (SNA) was employed to construct a movement network, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) were used for spatial visualization. Network analysis was performed in R, with centrality measures applied to identify key nodes in the poultry movement network.
analysis.main_results: Three predominant network nodes were identified with high degree and betweenness centrality values. The network exhibited low density but maintained critical transmission potential due to frequent bidirectional links and a heterogeneous structure.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights that a small number of highly connected municipalities act as hubs, enabling early disease emergence and rapid dissemination. This network-based approach provides a novel tool for prioritizing surveillance and control efforts in high-risk areas.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings enable veterinary authorities to target surveillance and interventions toward municipalities with the greatest risk of HPAI introduction or persistence, thereby protecting Morocco’s poultry industry and public health.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to the Casablanca-Settat region and relies on questionnaire-based data, which may not capture all movement patterns comprehensively. The evidence strength is moderate due to the cross-sectional design and absence of direct disease transmission data.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed poultry movement networks in Morocco’s Casablanca-Settat region to assess risks for highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) spread. Using a cross-sectional survey of 138 municipalities and 945 transport routes, researchers constructed a movement network via social network analysis (SNA) and GIS visualization. Three key hub municipalities with high centrality were identified, indicating that a small number of highly connected nodes drive network connectivity and transmission potential. Despite low network density, frequent bidirectional links and structural heterogeneity suggest rapid dissemination pathways. The authors propose that prioritizing surveillance and control in these hubs could mitigate HPAI risks, offering a targeted strategy to protect poultry and public health in Morocco.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 威胁着全球家禽业和公共卫生,而摩洛哥由于其沿迁徙路线和广泛的家禽贸易网络的地位,面临着更大的风险。该研究解决了家禽运动模式如何影响高致病性禽流感传播的知识差距,为有针对性的 监测 和控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在摩洛哥卡萨布兰卡-塞塔特地区进行了一项基于问卷调查的横断面调查,覆盖 9 个省和 138 个市,以绘制家禽流动模式图。该研究记录了 126 个城市的 945 条交通路线,并使用社交网络分析 (SNA) 和 GIS 可视化来表征网络结构。
elements_zh.methods: 采用社交网络分析(SNA)构建运动网络,并使用地理信息系统(GIS)进行空间可视化。在 R 中进行网络分析,并应用中心性度量来识别家禽运输网络中的关键节点。
elements_zh.main_results: 三个主要网络节点被确定为具有高度数和介数中心性值。该网络表现出低密度,但由于频繁的双向链接和异构结构而保持了关键的 传播 潜力。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,少数高度互联的城市充当枢纽,使疾病能够尽早出现并迅速传播。这种基于网络的方法提供了一种新颖的工具,用于优先考虑 监测 和高风险领域的控制工作。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现使兽医当局能够针对高致病性禽流感传入或持续存在最大风险的城市采取 监测 和干预措施,从而保护摩洛哥的家禽业和公共卫生。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于卡萨布兰卡-塞塔特地区,并依赖于基于问卷的数据,该数据可能无法全面捕获所有的运动模式。由于横断面设计和缺乏直接疾病 传播 数据,证据强度中等。

title_zh: 摩洛哥家禽业的流动网络分析:监测 和预防 高致病性禽流感 的工具
source_body_en: Background: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) poses a critical global threat to both the poultry industry and public health. Although Morocco currently maintains HPAI-free status, the country faces substantial risk due to its location along major migratory flyways and its extensive commercial trade networks within the poultry sector. Available data indicate that the links between live bird markets, production farms, and related facilities in the poultry sector constitute a pivotal determinant of disease epidemiology. This study aimed to analyze these movements and determine how they can influence the spread of the disease and to guide policymakers in developing effective risk-based surveillance and control strategies tailored to the local context.: A questionnaire-based cross-sectional survey was conducted across the Casablanca-Settat region, including nine provinces and 138 municipalities, to investigate the movement patterns within the poultry sector in this region. Social network analysis (SNA) was employed to construct a movement network, and findings were spatially visualized using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and analyzed through network analysis in R.: A total of 945 transport routes were recorded in 126 municipalities. Centrality measures identified three predominant network nodes exhibiting high degree and betweenness centrality values. Our findings indicate that although the network has a low density, the transmission of IAHP remains critical due to frequent bidirectional links and a heterogeneous network structure. The high concentration of movements by a few “hub” municipalities leads to an early emergence and rapid dissemination.: The identification of highly influential nodes allows veterinary authorities to prioritize and target surveillance activities toward municipalities with the greatest likelihood of disease introduction or persistence. The network’s structural connectivity suggests a theoretical potential for rapid HPAI spread, underscoring the importance of the frequent bidirectional links identified between municipalities. This protects both Morocco’s poultry industry and public health.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 威胁着全球家禽业和公共卫生,而摩洛哥由于其沿迁徙路线和广泛的家禽贸易网络的地位,面临着更大的风险。该研究解决了家禽运动模式如何影响高致病性禽流感传播的知识差距,为有针对性的 监测 和控制策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在摩洛哥卡萨布兰卡-塞塔特地区进行了一项基于问卷调查的横断面调查,覆盖 9 个省和 138 个市,以绘制家禽流动模式图。该研究记录了 126 个城市的 945 条交通路线,并使用社交网络分析 (SNA) 和 GIS 可视化来表征网络结构。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用社交网络分析(SNA)构建运动网络,并使用地理信息系统(GIS)进行空间可视化。在 R 中进行网络分析,并应用中心性度量来识别家禽运输网络中的关键节点。
analysis_zh.main_results: 三个主要网络节点被确定为具有高度数和介数中心性值。该网络表现出低密度,但由于频繁的双向链接和异构结构而保持了关键的 传播 潜力。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,少数高度互联的城市充当枢纽,使疾病能够尽早出现并迅速传播。这种基于网络的方法提供了一种新颖的工具,用于优先考虑 监测 和高风险领域的控制工作。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现使兽医当局能够针对高致病性禽流感传入或持续存在最大风险的城市采取 监测 和干预措施,从而保护摩洛哥的家禽业和公共卫生。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于卡萨布兰卡-塞塔特地区,并依赖于基于问卷的数据,该数据可能无法全面捕获所有的运动模式。由于横断面设计和缺乏直接疾病 传播 数据,证据强度中等。

title: Educação sanitária como estratégia de vigilância sanitária: relato de uma campanha extensionista sobre influenza aviária Sanitary education as a sanitary surveillance strategy: report of an extension campaign on avian influenza Educación sanitaria como estrategia de vigilancia sanitaria: relato de una campaña de extensión sobre influenza aviar
abstract: A Influenza Aviária (IA) constitui um importante desafio sanitário para a avicultura brasileira, setor no qual o país ocupa posição de destaque no cenário mundial. A recorrência de casos da enfermidade representa risco à sanidade animal, à saúde pública e à biodiversidade, além de potenciais impactos econômicos associados a restrições sanitárias e comerciais. Nesse contexto, ações de educação sanitária desenvolvidas no âmbito da extensão universitária assumem papel estratégico na disseminação de informações técnicas e na conscientização da sociedade. O presente trabalho teve como objetivo descrever e analisar uma campanha de educação em saúde sanitária sobre Influenza Aviária, desenvolvida como ação extensionista universitária, avaliando seu potencial como estratégia de conscientização e aproximação entre universidade e sociedade. A atividade foi realizada em outubro de 2025, com carga horária de quatro horas, durante a Semana Nacional de Ciência e Tecnologia (SNCT-2025), e envolveu a elaboração de materiais didáticos e o desenvolvimento de atividades educativas direcionadas à comunidade acadêmica, a produtores rurais e ao público do entorno. Foram abordados aspectos relacionados à etiologia, às formas de transmissão, aos sinais clínicos, às medidas de biosseguridade e à importância da notificação precoce da doença. A ação alcançou 50 participantes e possibilitou a transferência de conhecimentos técnicos de forma acessível, contribuindo para a ampliação do nível de informação e da conscientização sanitária. Os resultados evidenciam o potencial das ações extensionistas como ferramentas eficazes na prevenção de enfermidades de impacto coletivo, ao promoverem informação qualificada, participação social e fortalecimento da vigilância sanitária.
authors: Pamella Pryscila de Alvarenga Bissoli Maciel de Lima

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the public health and animal health challenges posed by avian influenza, which is a significant threat to Brazil's poultry industry and global health.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study describes an extension campaign conducted in October 2025 during the National Science and Technology Week (SNCT-2025), targeting 50 participants including academic community members, rural producers, and local residents.
analysis.methods: The campaign involved the development of educational materials and activities designed to disseminate technical information about avian influenza, including its etiology, transmission, clinical signs, biosafety measures, and the importance of early disease notification.
analysis.main_results: The campaign successfully reached 50 participants and facilitated the transfer of technical knowledge in an accessible manner, enhancing the level of health awareness and understanding of avian influenza among the target groups.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of extension activities in promoting public health awareness and strengthening sanitary surveillance, highlighting a novel approach to disease prevention through community engagement.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that extension campaigns can play a crucial role in improving public health preparedness and fostering collaboration between academic institutions and local communities in the context of avian influenza surveillance.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only report, which restricts the depth of analysis. However, the evidence provided supports a moderate confidence in the effectiveness of the extension campaign as a public health strategy.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents an extension campaign on avian influenza conducted in October 2025 during the National Science and Technology Week. The campaign aimed to raise awareness and disseminate technical knowledge about avian influenza among academic community members, rural producers, and local residents. It involved the creation of educational materials and activities covering etiology, transmission, clinical signs, biosafety measures, and early disease notification. The campaign reached 50 participants, contributing to increased health awareness and understanding. The authors interpret the results as demonstrating the potential of extension activities in promoting public health and strengthening sanitary surveillance. While the study is based on abstract-only evidence, it provides moderate confidence in the effectiveness of such campaigns for disease prevention and community engagement.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决 禽流感 带来的公共卫生和动物健康挑战,该挑战对巴西家禽业和全球健康构成重大威胁。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了 2025 年 10 月国家科技周 (SNCT-2025) 期间开展的一项推广活动,目标包括学术界成员、农村生产者和当地居民在内的 50 名参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 该活动涉及开发教育材料和活动,旨在传播有关 禽流感 的技术信息,包括其病因学、传播、临床症状、生物安全措施以及早期疾病通知的重要性。
elements_zh.main_results: 该活动成功吸引了 50 名参与者,促进了技术知识的便捷传播,提高了目标群体的健康意识和对 禽流感 的理解水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为证明了推广活动在提高公众健康意识和加强卫生 监测 方面的有效性,强调了通过社区参与预防疾病的新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,在 禽流感 监测 的背景下,推广活动可以在改善公共卫生准备和促进学术机构与当地社区之间的合作方面发挥至关重要的作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于摘要报告,限制了分析的深度。然而,所提供的证据支持对推广活动作为一项公共卫生战略的有效性有一定的信心。

title_zh: Educação sanitária como estratégia de vigilância sanitária: relato de uma Campanha Extensionista sobre Influenza aviária 作为卫生 监测 战略的卫生教育:关于 禽流感 推广活动的报告严重流行性感冒
source_body_en: A Influenza Aviária (IA) constitui um importante desafio sanitário para a avicultura brasileira, setor no qual o país ocupa posição de destaque no cenário mundial. A recorrência de casos da enfermidade representa risco à sanidade animal, à saúde pública e à biodiversidade, além de potenciais impactos econômicos associados a restrições sanitárias e comerciais. Nesse contexto, ações de educação sanitária desenvolvidas no âmbito da extensão universitária assumem papel estratégico na disseminação de informações técnicas e na conscientização da sociedade. O presente trabalho teve como objetivo descrever e analisar uma campanha de educação em saúde sanitária sobre Influenza Aviária, desenvolvida como ação extensionista universitária, avaliando seu potencial como estratégia de conscientização e aproximação entre universidade e sociedade. A atividade foi realizada em outubro de 2025, com carga horária de quatro horas, durante a Semana Nacional de Ciência e Tecnologia (SNCT-2025), e envolveu a elaboração de materiais didáticos e o desenvolvimento de atividades educativas direcionadas à comunidade acadêmica, a produtores rurais e ao público do entorno. Foram abordados aspectos relacionados à etiologia, às formas de transmissão, aos sinais clínicos, às medidas de biosseguridade e à importância da notificação precoce da doença. A ação alcançou 50 participantes e possibilitou a transferência de conhecimentos técnicos de forma acessível, contribuindo para a ampliação do nível de informação e da conscientização sanitária. Os resultados evidenciam o potencial das ações extensionistas como ferramentas eficazes na prevenção de enfermidades de impacto coletivo, ao promoverem informação qualificada, participação social e fortalecimento da vigilância sanitária.

title: Highly persistent antibody levels but limited population immunity in gannets after HPAI outbreak
abstract: The recent large-scale circulation of High Pathogenicity Avian Influenza (HP AI) viruses H5Nx of clade 2.3.4.4b has been responsible for massive die-offs in wild species, notably in long-lived seabirds, with unknown implications for the immunity of surviving individuals. In the North Atlantic, northern gannet colonies were heavily affected in 2022, with more than 40% mortality observed among breeding adults and some surviving individuals developing dark irises. Using samples collected in 2023 and 2024 on Rouzic colony (France), we report persistent individual anti-AI antibody levels and seroneutralisation titres, with most of the immune individuals showing dark irises. A modelling approach further stressed the importance of long-lasting immunity in such species by showing that the proportion of individuals which kept their immunity between years strongly limited decreases in population size in case of repeated outbreaks. Overall, our results highlight the existence and importance of long-lasting immunity in long-lived species for population persistence.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the implications of the recent large-scale circulation of HPAI H5Nx viruses on the immunity of surviving individuals, particularly in long-lived seabirds, following massive die-offs.

The modelling approach indicated that the proportion of individuals maintaining immunity between years significantly limited population size decreases during repeated outbreaks.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that long-lasting immunity plays a crucial role in population persistence for long-lived species, highlighting the importance of immunity in mitigating the impact of repeated HPAI outbreaks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the dynamics of immunity in long-lived seabirds, which can inform surveillance and conservation strategies for avian influenza outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on samples collected from a single colony, which may limit generalisability. However, the evidence is strong due to the direct observation of persistent antibody levels and the use of a modelling approach to support the interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the implications of the recent large-scale circulation of HPAI H5Nx viruses on the immunity of surviving northern gannets in the North Atlantic. Using samples from the Rouzic colony in France collected in 2023 and 2024, the researchers report persistent anti-AI antibody levels and seroneutralisation titres, with most immune individuals showing dark irises. A modelling approach further demonstrates that long-lasting immunity significantly limits population size decreases during repeated outbreaks. The findings highlight the importance of immunity in long-lived species for population persistence, offering insights into surveillance and conservation strategies for avian influenza. However, the study is limited by its focus on a single colony, which may affect generalisability. The evidence is strong due to direct observations and the use of a robust modelling method.

title: Establishment of a rapid detection method for Tembusu virus based on MIRA-PfAgo.
abstract: In this study, a novel nucleic acid detection method based on multienzyme isothermal rapid amplification (MIRA) combined with the Pyrococcus furiosus Argonaute (PfAgo) cleavage system (MIRA-PfAgo) was developed for the detection of Tembusu virus (TMUV), an important pathogen threatening the waterfowl industry. The method targets the highly conserved NS5 gene of TMUV. Target nucleic acids are rapidly enriched by MIRA under isothermal conditions at 39°C, followed by PfAgo-mediated cleavage guided by sequence-specific guide DNA (gDNA), enabling visual detection through fluorescence signal output. Systematic optimization identified 0.5 μM gDNA, 1 μM PfAgo, and 5 mM Mn2+ as the optimal reaction conditions. The assay exhibited excellent specificity for TMUV, with no cross-reactivity observed with common waterfowl pathogens, including H9 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV-H9), duck enteritis virus (DEV), goose parvovirus (GPV), Muscovy duck reovirus (MDRV), Newcastle disease virus (NDV), and duck circovirus (DuCV). The sensitivity was 100 copies/μl. In the analysis of 21 clinical samples, the results of the MIRA-PfAgo assay were fully consistent with those obtained by RT-PCR. This method does not require complex thermal cycling equipment and combines high sensitivity, strong specificity, and operational simplicity, providing a reliable and practical technical tool for rapid on-site monitoring of TMUV.RESEARCH HIGHLIGHTSThis is the first study to utilize the MIRA-PfAgo detection assay for the detection of TMUV.The results are observable by the unaided eye.The developed assay potentially offers an alternative means for detection of TMUV, requiring minimal equipment.

title: Pre-existing systemic and nasal antibodies against avian H5 influenza A viruses vary according to childhood imprinting.
abstract: ABSTRACT Avian influenza A viruses (IAVs) pose a constant pandemic threat, with the recent 2.3.4.4b clade of the H5 subtype causing high pathogenicity and spreading across animal species and geographic locations. Understanding human pre-existing immunity to avian H5 IAV can inform on population susceptibility, a critical aspect of pandemic preparedness. To that end, we analyzed the IAV HA-specific antibodies across individuals born between 1928 and 1999 with different early life exposures to IAV subtypes. Individuals born prior to 1957 had the highest pre-existing serum antibodies to group 1 HA antigens, including the 2.3.4.4b H5 and a group 1 HA stem antigen. These birth year-specific patterns were not reflected in the limited pre-existing serum neutralizing antibodies detectable against a 2.3.4.4b H5 IAV or in H5-specific memory B cell populations. They were, however, evident in pre-existing nasal IgG and IgA titers to H5, which were greater in individuals born prior to 1957. Our findings demonstrate that the immunological biases afforded by early life exposure extend to antibodies detected in the nasal mucosa, the site of IAV replication. IMPORTANCE Understating pre-existing immunity to influenza A viruses (IAVs) of pandemic potential is an important aspect of pandemic preparedness. This includes an understanding of the heterogeneity of pre-existing immunity across the population. Here, we demonstrate that pre-existing antibodies to H5 IAV vary according to the year of birth and childhood imprinting. We demonstrate that this is the case for both systemic and nasal antibodies, highlighting the importance of understanding pre-existing mucosal immunity at the sites of influenza virus replication.

title: Drivers of Viral Spillover: An Examination of How Pathogens Spread
abstract: The occurrence of viral zoonotic spillover (the transmission of viruses from animals to humans) has attracted worldwide attention due to mounting concerns regarding viral threats such as avian influenza, Hendra, monkeypox, Nipah and bat coronaviruses. It is evident that these events deviate significantly from natural occurrences, being the conflation of ecological, environmental and social factors that are profoundly altering the boundaries between the animal and human domains. Consequently, in order to comprehend both the contemporary and prospective drivers of zoonotic viral spillover, a coordinated, comprehensive global One Health response is essential. The purpose of the present review is to analyze prevailing pathways of transmission between animal reservoirs and human populations. This examination involves the analysis of historical cases, including those of SARS and Ebola, as well as recent occurrences, such as the global pandemic of SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19). A secondary objective of this review is to comprehend the fundamental mechanisms of cross-species transmission. The development of effective strategies to mitigate the emergence of zoonotic viruses and prevent future pandemics is contingent on a robust understanding of these mechanisms. This analysis is key to identifying pandemic pathogens and preventing the spread of zoonotic viruses. In conclusion, the review provides a thorough evaluation of current global strategies to prevent the spread of zoonotic viruses, highlighting gaps in our understanding and areas for further research.

The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or consensus processes, but it outlines the methodology used to analyze transmission pathways and mechanisms.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that a coordinated global One Health approach is essential to understand and mitigate the drivers of zoonotic viral spillover. It emphasizes the importance of studying the mechanisms of cross-species transmission to develop effective strategies for preventing future pandemics.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights gaps in understanding the specific mechanisms of cross-species transmission for avian influenza A viruses. It also notes the complexity of these events, which involve multiple interacting factors, and the need for more comprehensive research to address these uncertainties.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that further research is needed to better understand the transmission dynamics of avian influenza A viruses and their zoonotic potential. It also implies the importance of strengthening surveillance systems and implementing targeted interventions to reduce the risk of future outbreaks.

title_zh: 病毒 跨物种溢出 的驱动因素:病原体传播方式的检查
source_body_en: The occurrence of viral zoonotic spillover (the transmission of viruses from animals to humans) has attracted worldwide attention due to mounting concerns regarding viral threats such as avian influenza, Hendra, monkeypox, Nipah and bat coronaviruses. It is evident that these events deviate significantly from natural occurrences, being the conflation of ecological, environmental and social factors that are profoundly altering the boundaries between the animal and human domains. Consequently, in order to comprehend both the contemporary and prospective drivers of zoonotic viral spillover, a coordinated, comprehensive global One Health response is essential. The purpose of the present review is to analyze prevailing pathways of transmission between animal reservoirs and human populations. This examination involves the analysis of historical cases, including those of SARS and Ebola, as well as recent occurrences, such as the global pandemic of SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19). A secondary objective of this review is to comprehend the fundamental mechanisms of cross-species transmission. The development of effective strategies to mitigate the emergence of zoonotic viruses and prevent future pandemics is contingent on a robust understanding of these mechanisms. This analysis is key to identifying pandemic pathogens and preventing the spread of zoonotic viruses. In conclusion, the review provides a thorough evaluation of current global strategies to prevent the spread of zoonotic viruses, highlighting gaps in our understanding and areas for further research.

title: Virus-Dependent Relative Contributions of Citric Acid and Benzalkonium Chloride to the Virucidal Efficacy of Combination Disinfectants
abstract: Chemical disinfectants used in livestock production commonly combine citric acid (CA) and benzalkonium chloride (BZK), yet the respective contributions of these active ingredients to virucidal efficacy remain poorly understood. This study quantified the relative contributions of CA and BZK against the non-enveloped foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV) and the enveloped avian influenza virus (AIV). Virucidal efficacy was evaluated using a full-factorial design comprising six CA concentrations and six BZK concentrations at contact times of 3 and 30 min. Log reduction values (LRVs) were analyzed by two-way ANOVA and multiple linear regression, and the relative importance of each predictor was estimated using the Lindeman–Merenda–Gold (LMG) method. FMDV inactivation was primarily determined by CA, which accounted for 99.99% and 99.87% of the explained variance at 3 and 30 min, respectively, whereas BZK and the interaction term contributed minimally. In contrast, BZK was the dominant determinant of AIV inactivation, explaining 69.79% and 78.02% of the variance at 3 and 30 min, respectively, while CA made a smaller contribution. These findings demonstrate that the dominant active ingredient in CA–BZK combination disinfectants differed markedly between the FMDV and AIV models examined. Quantifying the relative contribution of individual components provides a basis for the rational formulation and optimization of veterinary disinfectants for different target viruses.

analysis_zh.main_results: 对于 FMDV 灭活,CA 分别占 3 分钟和 30 分钟解释方差的 99.99% 和 99.87%,而 BZK 和相互作用项贡献最​​小。相比之下,BZK 是 AIV 失活的主要决定因素,分别解释了 3 分钟和 30 分钟方差的 69.79% 和 78.02%,CA 的贡献较小。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,FMDV 和 AIV 模型中 CA-BZK 组合消毒剂的主要活性成分有所不同,这凸显了根据目标病毒定制配方的必要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为兽用消毒剂的合理配制和优化提供了基础,特别是针对禽流感 A病毒等不同目标病毒。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象证据,并且结果仅针对口蹄疫病毒和禽流感病毒,这可能会影响对其他病毒的普遍适用性。

title: Comparative characterization of novel lipid nanoparticle adjuvants reveals distinct immunogenicity and reactogenicity profiles
abstract: Abstract Rational design of adjuvants that simultaneously increase immunogenicity and reduce reactogenicity remains a challenge for protein vaccine development. Conventional adjuvants, like aluminum salts, and oil-in-water emulsions (like MF59, AS03, and AddaVax), work well to increase antibody titers but have variable abilities to modulate innate immune pathways, sustain long-term humoral immunity, or effectively redirect the Th2-skewed cellular responses they typically induce. Recent advances in the use of pattern-recognition receptors (PRRs), including Toll-like receptors (TLR) such as TLR4 and TLR9 agonists as adjuvants, formulated within nanoemulsions, have highlighted the potential of combination adjuvants for manipulating such responses. IVAX-1, a combination adjuvant consisting of MPLA (TLR4 agonist), CpG ODN 1018 (TLR9 agonist), and AddaVax nanoemulsion, exemplifies this tactic. In animal models, strong Th1-biased responses are elicited, and protection against infection is enhanced compared to individual adjuvant components. However, transient weight loss and enhanced systemic inflammation are observed with IVAX-1. To test the hypothesis that adjuvant delivery platform and TLR agonists influence the balance between immunogenicity and reactogenicity, we developed and characterized novel adjuvant formulations in which the model H5N1 hemagglutinin protein antigen was formulated with AddaVax or lipid nanoparticles, with or without incorporation of MPLA and or CpG. Our objective was to identify an alternative to IVAX-1 capable of co-delivering antigen and TLR agonists to reduce systemic reactogenicity without compromising immunogenicity or efficacy against H5N1 challenge. Our findings suggest that TLR agonist, adjuvant delivery platform and lipid composition play a central role in innate activation, adaptive immune polarization, and overall vaccine performance. Together, these results provide insight into the rational design of next-generation combination adjuvants for protein-based vaccines.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决设计佐剂的挑战,在蛋白质 疫苗 开发中增强免疫原性,同时降低反应原性。背景强调,传统佐剂,如铝盐和水包油乳剂,可以有效增加抗体滴度,但在调节先天免疫途径、维持长期体液免疫或重定向 Th2 倾斜的细胞反应方面具有不同的能力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及新型佐剂制剂的开发和表征,特别关注模型 H5N1 血凝素蛋白抗原。这些制剂使用 AddaVax 或脂质纳米颗粒在动物模型中进行了测试,无论是否包含 MPLA 和 CpG ODN 1018。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过将 TLR 激动剂(MPLA 和 CpG ODN 1018)掺入脂质纳米颗粒或 AddaVax 中,开发并表征了新型佐剂制剂。他们在动物模型中评估了这些制剂的免疫原性和反应原性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在动物模型中,IVAX-1(一种包含 MPLA、CpG ODN 1018 和 AddaVax 纳米乳剂的组合佐剂)与单独的佐剂成分相比,可引发强烈的 Th1 偏向反应并增强对感染的保护。然而,IVAX-1 观察到短暂的体重减轻和全身炎症增强。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为 TLR 激动剂、佐剂递送平台和脂质成分显着影响先天激活、适应性免疫极化和 疫苗 性能的证据。这项研究为基于蛋白质的 疫苗 的下一代组合佐剂的合理设计提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为基于蛋白质的 疫苗 的下一代组合佐剂的开发提供信息,特别是针对 禽流感 A 病毒的佐剂。这可能会导致改进的 疫苗 策略,具有更好的免疫原性和更低的反应原性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于动物模型,结果可能无法直接转化为人类应用。证据基于对这些模型的观察,这些模型可能无法完全捕捉人类 免疫应答 的复杂性。证据强度中等。

title: Computational Approaches for Influenza Reassortment Signal Inference in Environmental and Mixed Samples: Scoping Review (Preprint)
abstract: BACKGROUND Avian influenza virus reassortment is a major driver of viral evolution and the emergence of strains with altered pathogenicity, transmissibility, and zoonotic potential. Environmental surveillance has expanded as a population-level approach for influenza monitoring, yet inferring reassortment signals from environmental, pooled, and mixed samples remains challenging. OBJECTIVE This scoping review aimed to examine the computational methodologies used to infer and interpret influenza reassortment signals in environmental, pooled, or mixed samples. METHODS This scoping review was conducted according to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews guidelines. PubMed and Scopus were searched for studies applying computational methods to infer influenza reassortment in environmental, pooled, or mixed samples, with additional studies identified through citation tracking. Included studies were characterized by sample type, sequencing approach, and computational methodology used for reassortment inference. RESULTS Of 432 records screened, 48 studies were identified for this review. Most studies focused on low-complexity environmental samples, particularly fecal and surface swabs collected from live poultry markets and wild bird environments, whereas highly heterogeneous sample types such as municipal wastewater were mostly absent. All included studies relied on segment-wise phylogenetic incongruence as the primary basis for reassortment inference, with 56.3% supplementing tree comparisons using sequence similarity or genetic distance metrics. No studies applied formal statistical phylogenetic incongruence tests or dedicated reassortment-specific computational tools. Most workflows simplified sample complexity through virus isolation before sequencing, limiting their applicability to mixed viral populations. CONCLUSIONS Current computational approaches for environmental influenza reassortment inference remain largely adapted from isolate-based analyses and are not well suited for complex mixed-population samples. Future surveillance efforts would benefit from computational methods capable of resolving mixed viral lineages, together with standardized reporting practices and sequencing workflows, to improve early detection of emerging reassortment signals.

abstract_zh: 背景 禽流感 病毒重配是病毒 进化 和致病性、传播性和人畜共患潜力改变的菌株出现的主要驱动因素。环境 监测 已扩展为一种人群水平的流感监测方法,但从环境、混合和混合样本中推断重配信号仍然具有挑战性。目的 本次范围审查旨在检查用于推断和解释环境、混合或混合样本中流感重配信号的计算方法。方法 本次范围界定审查是根据系统评价的首选报告项目和范围界定审查指南的荟萃分析扩展进行的。在 PubMed 和 Scopus 中检索了应用计算方法来推断环境、混合或混合样本中流感重配的研究,并通过引文跟踪确定了其他研究。纳入的研究以样本类型、测序方法和用于重配推断的计算方法为特征。结果 在筛选的 432 份记录中,确定了 48 项研究用于本次审查。大多数研究集中于低复杂性的环境样本,特别是从活禽市场和 野生鸟类 环境中收集的粪便和表面拭子,而高度异质的样本类型(例如城市废水)大多不存在。所有纳入的研究都依赖分段系统发育不一致作为重配推断的主要基础,其中 56.3% 使用序列相似性或遗传距离度量补充树比较。没有研究应用正式的统计系统发育不一致测试或专用的重配特定计算工具。大多数工作流程通过测序前的病毒分离来简化样本的复杂性,从而限制了它们对混合病毒群体的适用性。结论 当前环境流感重配推断的计算方法仍然很大程度上适应于基于分离株的分析,并且不太适合复杂的混合群体样本。未来的 监测 工作将受益于能够解析混合病毒谱系的计算方法,以及标准化的报告实践和测序工作流程,以改善对新兴重配信号的早期检测。

title: Zoonotic disease risk perceptions associated with commercial wildlife activities in Southeast Asia: A scoping review
abstract: Abstract Background : Zoonotic disease emergence is closely linked to human-wildlife interactions, particularly in commercial wildlife activities where livelihoods, conservation, and health intersect. In Southeast Asia, wildlife hunting, trade, and farming remain integral to many communities, yet limited evidence has been synthesized on how communities engaged in these activities perceive associated zoonotic disease risks. This scoping review examines community perceptions of zoonotic disease risks associated with commercial wildlife activities and explores their implications for One Health research and practice. Methods : Peer-reviewed studies published in English between 2000 and 2024 were identified through PubMed and Google Scholar. Eligible studies examining community perceptions of health or zoonotic disease risks associated with wildlife hunting, trade, farming, or consumption in Southeast Asia were included in the review. Data were extracted and analyzed thematically to identify patterns, knowledge gaps, and implications for research and practice. Results : Eight studies from Thailand, Indonesia, the Lao People’s Democratic Republic, and Myanmar met the inclusion criteria. Studies used qualitative or mixed-methods approaches involving hunters, traders, farmers, consumers, and communities with wildlife contact. Study findings showed partial awareness of zoonotic risks among study populations, often limited to diseases such as avian influenza and rabies. Gaps in translating awareness into preventive practices were highlighted, driven by livelihood dependence, poverty, limited access to services and facilities, and broader structural constraints. Cultural beliefs, gender, and education also shaped risk perceptions and responses, and illegal or informal trade contexts complicated engagement and data collection. Conclusions : Community perceptions of zoonotic disease risk in Southeast Asia are shaped by intersecting social, economic, cultural, and livelihood factors. Effective strategies to reduce zoonotic disease risk associated with commercial wildlife activities require cross-sectoral, context-sensitive approaches that integrate community perspectives into communication and services across the conservation, public health, agriculture, and veterinary sectors. Risk reduction strategies should also move beyond awareness raising to address structural barriers that limit communities’ access to relevant information and services, thereby supporting more equitable and sustainable zoonotic disease prevention in Southeast Asia. One Health impact statement This scoping review highlights the importance of understanding how communities engaged in commercial wildlife activities perceive zoonotic disease risks at the human-animal-environment interfaces in Southeast Asia. By synthesizing limited evidence across health, social, and ecological dimensions, the review demonstrates that awareness of zoonotic disease risks alone is often insufficient to support preventive practices when livelihood dependence, limited access to services, sociocultural beliefs, and broader structural barriers shape decision-making and behaviors. The findings underscore the importance of integrating community perspectives into One Health research and implementation through context-sensitive, cross-sectoral approaches involving conservation, public health, agriculture, and veterinary sectors. While community perceptions alone do not constitute transdisciplinary One Health practice, understanding local experiences, priorities, and constraints provides a critical foundation for coproducing more equitable, culturally grounded, and sustainable zoonotic disease prevention strategies.

abstract_original: Abstract Background : Zoonotic disease emergence is closely linked to human-wildlife interactions, particularly in commercial wildlife activities where livelihoods, conservation, and health intersect. In Southeast Asia, wildlife hunting, trade, and farming remain integral to many communities, yet limited evidence has been synthesized on how communities engaged in these activities perceive associated zoonotic disease risks. This scoping review examines community perceptions of zoonotic disease risks associated with commercial wildlife activities and explores their implications for One Health research and practice. Methods : Peer-reviewed studies published in English between 2000 and 2024 were identified through PubMed and Google Scholar. Eligible studies examining community perceptions of health or zoonotic disease risks associated with wildlife hunting, trade, farming, or consumption in Southeast Asia were included in the review. Data were extracted and analyzed thematically to identify patterns, knowledge gaps, and implications for research and practice. Results : Eight studies from Thailand, Indonesia, the Lao People’s Democratic Republic, and Myanmar met the inclusion criteria. Studies used qualitative or mixed-methods approaches involving hunters, traders, farmers, consumers, and communities with wildlife contact. Study findings showed partial awareness of zoonotic risks among study populations, often limited to diseases such as avian influenza and rabies. Gaps in translating awareness into preventive practices were highlighted, driven by livelihood dependence, poverty, limited access to services and facilities, and broader structural constraints. Cultural beliefs, gender, and education also shaped risk perceptions and responses, and illegal or informal trade contexts complicated engagement and data collection. Conclusions : Community perceptions of zoonotic disease risk in Southeast Asia are shaped by intersecting social, economic, cultural, and livelihood factors. Effective strategies to reduce zoonotic disease risk associated with commercial wildlife activities require cross-sectoral, context-sensitive approaches that integrate community perspectives into communication and services across the conservation, public health, agriculture, and veterinary sectors. Risk reduction strategies should also move beyond awareness raising to address structural barriers that limit communities’ access to relevant information and services, thereby supporting more equitable and sustainable zoonotic disease prevention in Southeast Asia. One Health impact statement This scoping review highlights the importance of understanding how communities engaged in commercial wildlife activities perceive zoonotic disease risks at the human-animal-environment interfaces in Southeast Asia. By synthesizing limited evidence across health, social, and ecological dimensions, the review demonstrates that awareness of zoonotic disease risks alone is often insufficient to support preventive practices when livelihood dependence, limited access to services, sociocultural beliefs, and broader structural barriers shape decision-making and behaviors. The findings underscore the importance of integrating community perspectives into One Health research and implementation through context-sensitive, cross-sectoral approaches involving conservation, public health, agriculture, and veterinary sectors. While community perceptions alone do not constitute transdisciplinary One Health practice, understanding local experiences, priorities, and constraints provides a critical foundation for coproducing more equitable, culturally grounded, and sustainable zoonotic disease prevention strategies.

abstract_zh: 摘要背景:人畜共患疾病的出现与人类与野生动物的相互作用密切相关,特别是在生计、保护和健康交叉的商业野生动物活动中。在东南亚,野生动物狩猎、贸易和农业仍然是许多社区不可或缺的一部分,但关于从事这些活动的社区如何看待相关的人畜共患疾病风险,综合证据有限。本范围审查考察了社区对与商业野生动物活动相关的人畜共患疾病风险的看法,并探讨了它们对 One Health 研究和实践的影响。方法:通过 PubMed 和 Google Scholar 识别 2000 年至 2024 年以英文发表的同行评审研究。审查中纳入了符合条件的研究,该研究考察了社区对东南亚野生动物狩猎、贸易、农业或消费相关的健康或人畜共患疾病风险的看法。数据被提取并按主题进行分析,以确定模式、知识差距以及对研究和实践的影响。结果:来自泰国、印度尼西亚、老挝人民民主共和国和缅甸的八项研究符合纳入标准。研究采用定性或混合方法,涉及猎人、贸易商、农民、消费者和与野生动物接触的社区。研究结果显示,研究人群对人畜共患风险的认识有限,通常仅限于 禽流感 和狂犬病等疾病。由于生计依赖、贫困、获得服务和设施的机会有限以及更广泛的结构性限制,在将认识转化为预防实践方面存在着差距。文化信仰、性别和教育也影响了风险认知和应对措施,非法或非正式贸易环境使参与和数据收集变得复杂。结论:东南亚社区对人畜共患疾病风险的看法是由社会、经济、文化和生计等交叉因素决定的。减少与野生动物商业活动相关的人畜共患疾病风险的有效策略需要采取跨部门、因地制宜的方法,将社区观点纳入保护、公共卫生、农业和兽医部门的沟通和服务中。降低风险战略还应超越提高认识的范围,解决限制社区获取相关信息和服务的结构性障碍,从而支持东南亚更加公平和可持续的人畜共患疾病预防。一份健康影响声明 这项范围界定审查强调了了解从事商业野生动物活动的社区如何看待东南亚人类与动物环境界面上的人畜共患疾病风险的重要性。通过综合健康、社会和生态方面的有限证据,该审查表明,当生计依赖、获得服务的机会有限、社会文化信仰和更广泛的结构性障碍影响决策和行为时,仅对人畜共患疾病风险的认识往往不足以支持预防措施。研究结果强调了通过涉及保护、公共卫生、农业和兽医部门的具体情况敏感的跨部门方法将社区观点纳入同一个健康研究和实施的重要性。虽然社区认知本身并不能构成跨学科的“同一个健康”实践,但了解当地经验、优先事项和限制因素为共同制定更公平、有文化基础和可持续的人畜共患疾病预防策略提供了重要基础。

title: Sublingual NS1-truncated canine influenza live attenuated vaccine induces lung-sparing immunity and supports orodispersible film delivery
abstract: Safe mucosal delivery of live respiratory vaccines remains challenging. We developed CIV SA1 , an NS1-truncated H3N2 canine influenza live attenuated vaccine (LAIV), and evaluated sublingual administration as a non-respiratory mucosal route. In mice, high-dose sublingual CIV SA1 produced no recoverable infectious virus or histopathologic injury in lungs, whereas intranasal dosing produced pulmonary replication. A single sublingual dose induced serum IgG with hemagglutination-inhibition and neutralizing activity comparable to intranasal vaccination, enriched upper-airway IgA/IgG, and elicited IFN-γ cellular recall. Following lethal mouse-adapted CIV challenge, sublingual and intranasal LAIV preserved survival and markedly suppressed recoverable infectious virus in lungs and nasal washes. Following wild-type CIV challenge, sublingual LAIV also suppressed recoverable infectious virus in both compartments. CIV SA1 formulated as a gelatin-CMC orodispersible film preserved infectivity, released vaccine cargo rapidly in artificial saliva, was locally tolerated in beagles without detectable shedding, and induced systemic functional antibodies, upper-airway IgA/IgG, and peripheral IFN-γ cellular responses, supporting needle-free veterinary delivery.

title: Report on influenza viruses received and tested by the Melbourne WHO Collaborating Centre for Reference and Research on Influenza during 2025
abstract: As part of its role in the World Health Organization (WHO) Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System (GISRS), the WHO Collaborating Centre for Reference and Research on Influenza in Melbourne (the Centre) received 13,817 human influenza-positive samples during 2025. Viruses were analysed for their antigenic, genetic, and antiviral susceptibility properties. Selected viruses were propagated in qualified cells or embryonated hens’ eggs for potential use in seasonal influenza virus vaccines. Of the 13,817 samples received or processed, influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses predominated, accounting for 46.1% of samples, compared to 21.2% for A(H3N2) viruses and 19.5% for influenza B viruses; one influenza C virus was received. Among viruses analysed at the Centre, the majority of A(H1N1)pdm09 (> 99%) and influenza B (98%) viruses were antigenically similar to their respective WHO recommended vaccine strains for the Southern Hemisphere in 2025. In contrast, only 43% of A(H3N2) viruses were antigenically similar to their respective WHO recommended vaccine strains. Of 3,307 samples tested for susceptibility to the neuraminidase inhibitors oseltamivir and zanamivir, 37 A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses showed highly reduced inhibition by oseltamivir and no influenza viruses tested showed highly reduced inhibition by zanamivir. Of 5,080 samples with sequencing of the polymerase acidic (PA) gene, no genetic markers associated with highly reduced susceptibility to baloxavir marboxil were identified.

title: First detection and phylogenetic analysis of porcine parainfluenza virus 1 and swine orthopneumovirus in swine reared on commercial farms in Serbia
abstract: Abstract Introduction Porcine parainfluenza virus 1 (PPIV1) and swine orthopneumovirus (SOV) are recently discovered respiratory viruses of swine. Data on their geographic distribution and genetic diversity are scarce. This study investigated the presence of these viruses in diseased pigs on commercial farms in Serbia and also the phylogenetic characteristics of the detected strains. Material and Methods A total of 131 samples were collected during passive surveillance of swine influenza in pigs from 10 commercial farms. All samples were screened by real-time RT-PCR for swine influenza A virus (SIV) and PPIV1, and 77 of them were tested for SOV. Positive samples were further subjected to conventional RT-PCR targeting the PPIV1 F and SOV G genes, sequencing, and phylogenetic analysis. Results Farm-level prevalence was 60% for SIV, 50% for PPIV1 and 10% for SOV. Overall, 27 samples were positive for SIV, 18 for PPIV1 and 2 for SOV. Co-circulation of two viruses was evident on four farms, and on one farm, all the tested viruses were detected. Phylogenetically, three Serbian PPIV1 strains clustered together with European and Asian strains, and SOV strains grouped with swine, murine and canine pneumoviruses, confirming their close evolutionary relationship. Conclusion This is the first evidence of PPIV1 and SOV circulation on pig farms in Serbia. Even established phylogenetic patterns are consistent with those reported in Europe, expanded surveillance is needed to better define the prevalence and genetic diversity of these emerging respiratory viruses in Serbian pig populations.

title: What severe respiratory disease teaches us about vaccine design: the expanding reach of Matrix-M
abstract: “Durability informs those priorities because the predominantly Th1-biased response Matrix-M generates is relevant to the quality and length of protection and shapes our antigen and adjuvant design across the pipeline.”Ashling Cannon, Editor, Vaccine Insights , speaks with Robert Walker, Executive Vice President, Head of Research & Development, Novavax, about how a clinical background in pulmonary and critical care medicine shapes Novavax’s approach to vaccine immunology. They discuss the mechanistic basis for their technology’s tolerability profile, the expanding utility of the Matrix-M adjuvant across infectious disease and oncology, H5N1 pandemic preparedness strategy, the early-stage Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile) program, and Novavax’s research priorities following the transition of Nuvaxovid commercialization to Sanofi.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore how the immunological response generated by the Th1-biased Matrix-M adjuvant informs vaccine design priorities for severe respiratory diseases, particularly in the context of avian influenza A viruses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The discussion centered on the clinical and research priorities of Novavax, including the development of vaccines against avian influenza A viruses, with a focus on H5N1 and other subtypes, and their broader applications in infectious disease and oncology.
analysis.methods: The analysis involved a conversation with Robert Walker, Executive Vice President, Head of Research & Development at Novavax, where they discussed the mechanistic basis of their technology’s tolerability profile and the expanding utility of the Matrix-M adjuvant across various disease areas.
analysis.main_results: The results highlighted the relevance of the Th1-biased response generated by Matrix-M to the quality and length of protection against severe respiratory diseases, including avian influenza A viruses, and its potential for application in pandemic preparedness strategies.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the importance of understanding immunological responses in vaccine design, particularly for avian influenza A viruses, and noted the novelty of the Matrix-M adjuvant’s expanding reach across different therapeutic areas.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more effective vaccines for avian influenza A viruses and other severe respiratory pathogens, with implications for pandemic preparedness and the design of immunological strategies that enhance durability of protection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on a discussion and does not include direct experimental results, which limits its strength. However, the insights are grounded in the company’s research priorities and are considered relevant to the topic.

analysis.summary_en: This article discusses the role of the Th1-biased immunological response generated by the Matrix-M adjuvant in shaping vaccine design priorities for severe respiratory diseases, particularly avian influenza A viruses. The conversation with Robert Walker highlights the adjuvant’s expanding utility in infectious disease and oncology, as well as its relevance to pandemic preparedness strategies. The findings suggest that understanding immunological responses is critical for developing durable vaccines against avian influenza and other pathogens. While the evidence is based on a discussion rather than direct experimental results, it provides valuable insights into the company’s research focus and the potential of Matrix-M in vaccine development. The study underscores the importance of immunological durability in vaccine design and its implications for public health preparedness.

title: Newton Divided Difference Optimization for Fingerprint-Based Neural Virtual Screening against Avian Influenza A/H9N2
abstract: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感 A/H9N2 造成持续的人畜共患病和兽医威胁,但用于 抗病毒药物 化合物优先级排序的有效计算工具仍然不发达,特别是在高维神经筛选中的​​优化器行为方面。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究提出牛顿差分(NDD)优化作为一种​​针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的新型优化器,目的是评估其在对齐的分子指纹表示和化学结构验证协议中的性能。
elements_zh.methods: 由 615 种候选活性化合物和 844 种诱饵组成的 1,459 个分子的对齐基准由 EState(79 个特征)、PubChem(881 个特征)和 Klekota–Roth(4,860 个特征)指纹代表,共享相同的分子身份、标签和分割分配。固定多层感知器 (MLP) 分类器使用 NDD 和七个基线优化器在分层、支架键和相似性聚类分割协议下跨五个重复种子进行训练。
elements_zh.main_results: NDD 在支架关键和相似性聚类协议下在 Klekota–Roth 指纹上实现了最高的描述性 ROC-AUC 和 PR-AUC,并且在分层分割下保持竞争力,ROC-AUC 为 0.9872。架构敏感性测试证实了跨多种网络配置的稳定 NDD 性能,ROC-AUC 值范围为 0.9876 至 0.9890。与无 Hessian 优化相比,在相同的仅 CPU 配置下,NDD 将 Klekota-Roth 上的每次运行时间从大约 50-54 秒减少到大约 8 秒,同时实现了相当的排名性能。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项工作的新颖性在于首次对 H9N2 神经虚拟筛选的 NDD 进行系统评估,证明正对角线曲率感知缩放在基于稀疏高维配体的筛选设置中提供了实用、稳定且计算高效的优化替代方案。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的 抗病毒药物 化合物优先排序提供了一种计算有效的优化策略,这可以加速针对这种人畜共患威胁的潜在治疗方法的发现。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 在实施实际的 抗病毒药物 优先级排序之前,外部验证和前瞻性实验确认仍然是必要的。由于研究的计算性质和实验验证的需要,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 禽流感 A/H9N2 造成持续的人畜共患病和兽医威胁,但用于 抗病毒药物 化合物优先级排序的有效计算工具仍然不发达,特别是在高维神经筛选中的​​优化器行为方面。本研究提出了牛顿除差(NDD)优化,这是一种轻量级正对角曲率感知训练策略,作为针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的新型优化器,目的是评估其在对齐的分子指纹表示和化学结构验证协议中的性能。由 615 种候选活性化合物和 844 种诱饵组成的 1,459 个分子的对齐基准由 EState(79 个特征)、PubChem(881 个特征)和 Klekota–Roth(4,860 个特征)指纹代表,共享相同的分子身份、标签和分割分配。固定多层感知器 (MLP) 分类器使用 NDD 和七个基线优化器在分层、支架键和相似性聚类分割协议下跨五个重复种子进行训练。NDD 在支架密钥和相似性聚类协议下的 Klekota–Roth 指纹上实现了最高的描述性 ROC-AUC(接收者操作特征 - 曲线下面积)和 PR-AUC(曲线下精确召回面积),并且在分层分割下保持竞争力,ROC-AUC 为 0.9872。架构敏感性测试证实了跨多种网络配置的稳定 NDD 性能,ROC-AUC 值范围为 0.9876 至 0.9890。与无 Hessian 优化相比,在相同的仅 CPU 配置下,NDD 将 Klekota-Roth 上的每次运行时间从大约 50-54 秒减少到大约 8 秒,同时实现了相当的排名性能。这项工作的新颖性在于首次系统评估 H9N2 神经虚拟筛选的 NDD,证明正对角线曲率感知缩放在稀疏高维配体筛选设置中提供了实用、稳定且计算高效的优化替代方案,尽管在实际 抗病毒药物 优先级排序之前仍然需要外部验证和前瞻性实验确认。

full_text: Abstract Avian influenza viruses (AIV) have a remarkable capacity to adapt through rapid mutation and cross-species transmission, posing a major global pandemic threat. The distinct spatial patterns of outbreaks suggest that the relationship between disease emergence and ecological drivers is complex, non-linear, and varies with virus pathogenicity and host characteristics. Here, we used a multi-algorithm machine learning statistical framework and 27 ecological features to analyze over 50,000 outbreaks reported across Eurasia and Africa from 2004 to 2025, stratifying the data into highly pathogenic (HPAI), low-pathogenic (LPAI), domestic, and wild-bird subsets. Our models achieved high predictive performance (accuracies ≥ 84%) and revealed distinct, strata-specific risk profiles driven by strong non-linear interactions. For the all-AIV and wild-bird cohorts, vegetation indices and wetland proximity were the most important predictors of spatial risk. Conversely, domestic duck and chicken densities dominated predictions for the LPAI and domestic poultry subsystems, while proximity to LPAI outbreaks was the strongest driver of HPAI risk. Although underreporting in wildlife and developing regions limits data quality, this interpretable framework provides a flexible platform to support risk-based surveillance and to optimize targeted interventions at regional and global scales. title_original: Complex interactions between ecological and host factors drive continental patterns of avian influenza outbreak risk in Eurasia and Africa

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to understand how ecological and host factors interact to drive continental patterns of avian influenza outbreak risk in Eurasia and Africa, highlighting the complex and non-linear relationship between disease emergence and these factors.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed over 50,000 outbreaks reported across Eurasia and Africa from 2004 to 2025, stratifying the data into highly pathogenic (HPAI), low-pathogenic (LPAI), domestic, and wild-bird subsets.
analysis.methods: A multi-algorithm machine learning statistical framework was used, incorporating 27 ecological features to model the risk factors for avian influenza outbreaks across different strata.
analysis.main_results: The models achieved high predictive performance with accuracies ≥ 84%, revealing distinct, strata-specific risk profiles driven by strong non-linear interactions between ecological and host factors.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that vegetation indices and wetland proximity are key predictors for all-AIV and wild-bird cohorts, while domestic duck and chicken densities dominate predictions for the LPAI and domestic poultry subsystems, and proximity to HPAI outbreaks is the strongest driver for HPAI risk.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide a flexible framework for risk-based surveillance and targeted interventions, which can inform public health strategies to mitigate avian influenza outbreaks at regional and global scales.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges underreporting in wildlife and developing regions as a limitation, which may affect data quality, but the high predictive accuracy of the models supports a moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the complex interactions between ecological and host factors that drive continental patterns of avian influenza outbreak risk in Eurasia and Africa. Using a multi-algorithm machine learning framework and 27 ecological features, the researchers analyzed over 50,000 outbreaks from 2004 to 2025, stratified into highly pathogenic (HPAI), low-pathogenic (LPAI), domestic, and wild-bird subsets. The models achieved high predictive performance (accuracies ≥ 84%) and identified distinct risk profiles, with vegetation indices and wetland proximity being the most important predictors for all-AIV and wild-bird cohorts, while domestic duck and chicken densities dominated predictions for LPAI and domestic poultry. The findings suggest that these risk factors vary by outbreak type and host, offering a flexible platform for risk-based surveillance and targeted interventions. However, underreporting in wildlife and developing regions may limit data quality, and the study's conclusions are based on a moderate confidence level due to these limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解生态因素和 宿主 因素如何相互作用,从而驱动欧亚大陆和非洲 禽流感 暴发 风险的大陆模式,强调疾病出现与这些因素之间复杂且非线性的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 2004 年至 2025 年欧亚大陆和非洲报告的 50,000 多个 暴发,将数据分为高致病性 (HPAI)、低致病性 (LPAI)、家养鸟类和野生鸟类子集。
elements_zh.methods: 使用多算法机器学习统计框架,结合 27 个生态特征来对不同阶层的 禽流感 暴发 的风险因素进行建模。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型实现了高预测性能,准确度≥ 84%,揭示了由生态因素和 宿主 因素之间强烈的非线性相互作用驱动的独特的、特定阶层的风险状况。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,植被指数和湿地邻近度是全AIV和野鸟队列研究的关键预测因素,而家鸭和鸡的密度主导着LPAI和家禽子系统的预测,而与HPAI 暴发的邻近度是HPAI风险的最强驱动因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为基于风险的 监测 和有针对性的干预措施提供了灵活的框架,可以为公共卫生策略提供信息,以在区域和全球范围内减轻 禽流感 暴发 的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认野生动物和发展中地区的漏报是一个限制,这可能会影响数据质量,但模型的高预测准确性支持对研究结果的适度信心。

abstract_zh: 本研究采用多算法机器学习统计框架,并基于27个生态学特征,分析了2004年至2025年间在欧亚大陆和非洲报告的超过50,000例禽流感病例(暴发)。数据被分层为高致病性禽流感(HPAI)、低致病性禽流感(LPAI)、家禽和野生鸟类子集。摘要中禽流感病毒(AIV)具有通过快速突变和跨物种传播进行适应的显著能力,构成了重大全球大流行威胁。禽流感病例(暴发)的不同空间分布模式表明,疾病出现与生态驱动因素之间的关系复杂、非线性,并随病毒致病性和宿主特征而变化。我们的模型实现了高预测性能(准确率≥84%),并揭示了由强非线性相互作用驱动的、特定分层的风险特征。对于所有禽流感病例(队列研究)和野生鸟类子集,植被指数和湿地邻近度是空间风险的最重要预测因子。相反,家鸭和鸡的密度在LPAI和家禽子系统的预测中占主导地位,而LPAI禽流感病例(暴发)的邻近度则是HPAI风险的最强驱动因素。尽管野生动物和发展中地区的漏报限制了数据质量,但该可解释框架为支持基于风险的监测(监测)提供了灵活平台,并可在区域和全球尺度上优化有针对性的干预措施。资助 本手稿部分由美国农业部农业研究局(USDA:ARS)授予明尼苏达大学动物健康与食品安全中心的资助资助。伦理声明 利益冲突 作者声明无利益冲突。补充信息 出版商注 Springer Nature 在此方面保持中立。
